A subject-asserted Crossref relation is accepted as the journal-to-preprint identity assertion only after exact official arXiv target resolution; titles, numbers, search results, and topics do not establish identity.
An absent related DOI in arXiv metadata cannot positively confirm the journal DOI, but it is not an explicit conflict under the prespecified rule.
Crossref is a live registry; rerunning the same date census later may reflect subsequent depositor metadata updates, so this audit records the observed funnel and official URLs.
